name: whatsapp-agent
description: WhatsApp team inbox for ChatGPT. See which customers are waiting for a reply and for how long, who owns each WhatsApp chat, what every teammate handled and closed, and what your AI agent answered. Works with WhatsApp Business. Read-only: it never sends a message.

tools.name: whatsapp-overview
tools.title: Boards at a glance
tools.summary: shows how the team's WhatsApp stands right now: open, unanswered and unread chats per board, the Inbox, the longest wait and the connected line.

tools.name: whatsapp-list-boards
tools.title: List boards
tools.summary: lists the team's boards and their columns, and whether the Calypso Agent and follow-ups are on for each.

tools.name: whatsapp-list-chats
tools.title: List chats
tools.summary: lists open WhatsApp chats by board, column, state, owner or how long the customer has waited.

tools.name: whatsapp-find-chat
tools.title: Find a chat
tools.summary: finds a chat by contact name, phone number or words in the last message.

tools.name: whatsapp-open-chat
tools.title: Open a chat
tools.summary: shows one chat in full: its card, the latest messages, its follow-ups and WhatsApp's 24-hour reply window.

tools.name: whatsapp-read-messages
tools.title: Read a chat's messages
tools.summary: reads the messages of one chat, newest first, with who sent each and when.

tools.name: whatsapp-list-follow-ups
tools.title: List follow-ups
tools.summary: lists the follow-ups the Calypso Agent has planned, with their state and when each is due.

tools.name: whatsapp-agent-activity
tools.title: Agent and team activity
tools.summary: reports how conversations were handled over a period: by the Calypso Agent, by the team and by each teammate.

tools.name: whatsapp-list-conversations
tools.title: List conversations, closed ones included
tools.summary: lists conversations over a period, open and closed, with owner, times and who answered.

interface.longDescription:
WhatsApp Agent by Calypso puts your WhatsApp Business team inbox inside ChatGPT. Ask who is waiting for a reply, how long they have waited, who owns each chat and how your team did this week. The answers come from your live WhatsApp boards, not from a guess.

It is read-only. It never sends a message to your customers, and it never moves, assigns or closes a chat.

What you can ask:

* Who is waiting: every WhatsApp chat where the customer wrote last, with the minutes they have waited
* Team performance: conversations per teammate today or this week, closed ones included
* Response times: how long until a person takes a conversation, and how long until it is closed
* AI agent report: how many conversations your AI agent answered by itself, and how many a person took over
* Find a customer: search chats by contact name, phone number or the words in the last message
* Catch up before you reply: a summary of any WhatsApp conversation, with who said what and when
* Sales pipeline and support queue: your boards and columns, CRM style, with open, unread and unanswered counts
* Follow-ups: what is due today and what is waiting for someone to approve

How it works: connect with your Calypso account and choose a workspace. There is no API key to paste and nothing to install. It works with a WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business number linked by QR code, and with the WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API).

Who it is for: sales and customer support teams that share one WhatsApp number. Owners and team leads see the shared inbox, the workload and the response times in one answer. Agents find a chat and catch up in seconds.

Before you start: you need a Calypso WhatsApp workspace with a connected number. Create one at whatsapp.calypso.so.

WhatsApp Agent by Calypso is an independent product. It is not made by, affiliated with or endorsed by WhatsApp or Meta.
capabilities: See which WhatsApp customers are waiting, and for how long
Workload per teammate, closed conversations included
Find any chat by name, phone number or message text
Summarise a WhatsApp conversation before you reply
AI agent report: what it answered, what a person took over
Read-only: never sends, moves, assigns or closes a chat
defaultPrompts: Which customers are waiting for a reply on WhatsApp, and for how long?
Who on my team handled the most WhatsApp conversations this week?
Summarise the WhatsApp chat that has been waiting the longest

smokeTests.prompt: How is our WhatsApp inbox doing right now?
smokeTests.expect: whatsapp-overview; see how the WhatsApp inbox stands right now

smokeTests.prompt: Which customers are waiting for a reply on WhatsApp, and for how long?
smokeTests.expect: whatsapp-list-chats; list the customers waiting for a reply

smokeTests.prompt: Summarise the WhatsApp chat that has been waiting the longest.
Who on my team handled the most WhatsApp conversations in the last 7 days?
smokeTests.expect: whatsapp-agent-activity; compare the workload of each teammate

smokeTests.prompt: List the WhatsApp conversations we closed in the last 7 days and who owned each one.
smokeTests.expect: whatsapp-list-conversations; list the conversations that were closed

smokeTests.prompt: Send a WhatsApp message to +1 415 555 0134 saying our store opens at 9am.
smokeTests.expect: no tool call; whatsApp Agent never sends a message

smokeTests.prompt: Write a friendly WhatsApp greeting for new customers of a bakery.
smokeTests.expect: no tool call; writing a message stays with ChatGPT

smokeTests.prompt: Book me a meeting slot tomorrow at 3pm.
smokeTests.expect: no tool call; scheduling is out of scope

test_cases.description: See how the WhatsApp inbox stands right now
test_cases.prompt: How is our WhatsApp inbox doing right now?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Calls whatsapp-overview and reports, for each board, the open chats, how many are waiting on the team and how many are unread, plus the longest wait in minutes, using the numbers exactly as returned.

test_cases.description: List the customers waiting for a reply
test_cases.prompt: Which customers are waiting for a reply on WhatsApp, and for how long?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Calls whatsapp-list-chats for the chats where the customer wrote last and lists each one with its contact, board, owner and minutes waiting, longest wait first.

test_cases.prompt: Summarise the WhatsApp chat that has been waiting the longest.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Finds the chat that has waited longest with whatsapp-list-chats, then calls whatsapp-read-messages on it and summarises what the customer asked and what was answered, naming the contact and when the last message arrived.

test_cases.description: Compare the workload of each teammate
test_cases.prompt: Who on my team handled the most WhatsApp conversations in the last 7 days?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Calls whatsapp-agent-activity and ranks the teammates by the conversations each one owns, with how many of those are closed, and says how many the AI agent handled. States that a conversation counts for its current owner.

test_cases.description: List the conversations that were closed
test_cases.prompt: List the WhatsApp conversations we closed in the last 7 days and who owned each one.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Calls whatsapp-list-conversations for closed conversations in the period and lists each one with its contact, owner, when it closed and who answered last.

test_cases.description: WhatsApp Agent never sends a message
test_cases.prompt: Send a WhatsApp message to +1 415 555 0134 saying our store opens at 9am.
test_cases.routes_to: The Calypso boards at whatsapp.calypso.so (WhatsApp Agent only reads)
test_cases.expected_behavior: Does not call a tool. Says that WhatsApp Agent reads the team's WhatsApp but never sends a message, and that the team replies from the boards at whatsapp.calypso.so.

test_cases.description: Writing a message stays with ChatGPT
test_cases.prompt: Write a friendly WhatsApp greeting for new customers of a bakery.
test_cases.routes_to: ChatGPT without WhatsApp Agent (a writing task)
test_cases.expected_behavior: Does not call WhatsApp Agent. The request is to write a text, not to read the team's WhatsApp, so ChatGPT writes the greeting itself.

test_cases.prompt: Book me a meeting slot tomorrow at 3pm.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Does not call a tool. Explains that WhatsApp Agent reads the team's WhatsApp boards and cannot book meetings.

publication.releaseNotes: 1.0: your WhatsApp team inbox in ChatGPT. See who is waiting and for how long, find and summarise any chat, and compare what each teammate and your AI agent handled, closed conversations included. Read-only: it never sends a message.
